name: toes-out-leg-extension.html
instructions:
1. Select the desired resistance on the weight stack and adjust the seat so your knees align with the pivot point of the machine.
2. Place your feet under the pads with your toes pointed outward (away from each other).
3. Hold the side handles to stabilize your upper body. This is the starting position.
4. Slowly extend your legs by straightening your knees.
5. Pause and squeeze your quads at the top of the movement.
6. Slowly lower the weight back down to the starting position. This is one rep.
7. Complete the desired reps, focusing on controlling the movement.
